# Grablytic

> Private yt-dlp media downloader for Android, Linux & Windows. Highest-fidelity downloads from 1,000+ platforms — no ads, no tracking, 100% local. Free & open source (GPL-3.0).

- Site: https://grablytic.vercel.app/
- Repo: https://github.com/OnlyXianzo/Grablytic
- Releases: https://github.com/OnlyXianzo/Grablytic/releases/latest
- Install (Linux): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OnlyXianzo/Grablytic/main/install.sh | bash`
- Android: via GitHub Releases (`grablytic-v0.0.2-arm64-deno.apk` recommended) or Obtainium (`https://github.com/OnlyXianzo/Grablytic`)
- License: GPL-3.0 — https://github.com/OnlyXianzo/Grablytic/blob/main/LICENSE
- Security: https://github.com/OnlyXianzo/Grablytic/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- DMCA: https://github.com/OnlyXianzo/Grablytic/blob/main/DMCA.md
- Contact: xianzo.help@gmail.com
